inputs.note: A Discrepancy(kind=added), the intake_form module's exported names, and a LabWriteBackRequest carrying an intake document.

expected: A medication on the form and not in the chart is surfaced as an `added` discrepancy with a document citation and no chart side; no merge-shaped operation exists; the write-back request refuses an intake document outright.
guards_against: Auto-merging intake medications into the chart — invariant 5 and D2, and a patient-safety failure rather than a data-quality one.
